This report concerns the 23-page CVGMT-hosted manuscript by Giovanni Catino, Yanyan Li, Dario D. Monticelli, and Alberto Roncoroni, A Liouville theorem in the Heisenberg group [paper]. The exact source has 438267 bytes and SHA256 \[\text{\normalfont
7d4636e5a79dcc6e4d8a0f4a57b547417de162a7b1ca73d4f772cc8bffb2cb05}.\] All 23 pages, including references, were read as extracted text. CVGMT labels its record an accepted paper and gives 27 November 2024 as the record’s update date. That date is not an authenticated revision date for this PDF. Exact alignment with the accepted version, with arXiv:2310.10469, or with the journal version was not established. The associated journal DOI is 10.4171/JEMS/1705; the publisher records online publication on 15 September 2025 [journal]. Findings below are attributed only to the bound CVGMT file.
